採用・広告の製品.quote: Ethon’s AI Platform understands how your production processes behave in real-time, surfacing deviations and explaining what drives variation. It guides teams to optimize cost, quality, and speed while keeping operations under control across factories.
Same process, different outcomes.
Factories run the same process with different outcomes. Output and yield swing for reasons teams can’t clearly explain. Fixes that work in one site don’t reliably transfer to the next.
Teams are forced to piece together the truth across Historians, SCADA, MES, spreadsheets, and experience. What’s missing is clear visibility into cause and effect at the process level.
When conditions change and no system explains why, teams react late and enterprises pay for it – in scrap, rework, downtime, and missed targets.
The world’s top manufacturers use Ethon to understand, improve, and control their production processes.

Ethon connects production data from every source and learns how processes behave in real-time, including the sources of variation that cause outcomes to drift from run to run, line to line, and factory to factory.

Most tools show what changed. Ethon explains why it changed and what to do next. Using agentic workflows with causal reasoning, Ethon identifies which combinations of process settings, materials, equipment, and environmental conditions are driving productivity loss and which changes will stabilize outcomes.

Predict downtime and quality losses

Stay ahead of process deviations and equipment failures with real-time awareness. Ethon continuously monitors live production data, flags anomalies, and prescribes the right actions to prevent downtime and quality losses before they happen.
Trace every product and batch

Reconstruct the true flow of every part and batch across production. Ethon assigns data to each unit, traces it through every process step, and reveals deviations, rework loops, and bottlenecks from real production behavior.

Siemens building products are widely used in residential and commercial environments. Many of these products are safety-critical, making rigorous quality standards a top priority. This places high demands on visual inspection systems - demands that must be consistently met.

Growing product variety made it hard for Siemens to scale traditional visual inspection systems. Setting up and calibrating vision jobs for new product variants took significant time and effort. Missing defect images led to false negatives, wasting time on investigating issues that did not exist.

Ethon’s visual quality solution integrated plug & play across Siemens plants, despite varying environmental conditions such as lighting. It enabled real-time defect identification for new product variants within minutes, without complex reconfiguration. In addition, the system supports structured root cause analysis and end-to-end traceability for every unit across all product variants.

SFS produces high-quality components for demanding industries such as automotive, aerospace, and medical technology at high-volumes. They have previously invested in data collection initiatives and started realizing measurable benefits.

Increasing margin pressure and tight order deadlines make it essential to quickly reach stable and high yield during ongoing production and especially ramp-up periods to avoid costly overproduction. At the same time the growing volume of data makes it increasingly difficult to extract business critical insights. Think more than 200 influence factors per produced part.

SFS decided to use Ethon and help its engineering team identify complex root causes with greater reliability, supported by custom live dashboards for fast actions. In collaboration with Ethon's dedicated forward deployed team, a small group of engineers committed one day per week to establish live streaming of the production data and test the solution until go-live.
By embedding domain knowledge into the software setup provided by experienced engineers, junior engineers drive line improvements without requiring decades of experience.
Causal AI not only pinpoints root causes but also shows where additional data will deliver the greatest business value, helping prioritize and maximize data investments.
